definitions.ask: Which SASE projects may run agents that read Spotify data?
definitions.why: Lets home/love agents use music context; the guard still fails closed on public chats

choices.label: Any project whose agent chats stay private or unpublished; public ones are refused
Only the private sase-spotify project (+spotify); every other project is refused

definitions.ask: Should Spotify re-login be doable from the phone through a renewal gate?
definitions.why: Six-month expiry is the most likely failure, and one tap from Telegram keeps it reliable
